title: Chapter 10 — SUG Elections
description: Tobi runs for Student Union president against the Dons' candidate. He wants you as campaign manager.

beats.speaker: tobi
beats.text: Somto. I'm running for SUG president. Against Spike's boy, "Tunde Capo". If he wins, the Dons run the union budget. (He looks serious for once.) I need someone who can talk to the hostels. Not just my friends. Everybody.

beats.speaker: tobi
beats.text: And before you say anything: forget the fifteen thousand. Consider it your salary. (He grins.) Advance salary.

beats.speaker: tobi
beats.text: Campaign manager. No pay. Lots of jollof.

options.text: "I can't, Tobi. I'm one bad semester from losing everything."

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The manifesto debate. The cafeteria, packed to the ceiling fans. Tunde Capo promises free Wi-Fi, free shuttle buses and free "protection". Tobi has your notes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Election night. The ballot boxes are kept in the Senate basement. At 1 a.m. a hostel porter texts you: "Red bandanas carrying cartons into the basement."

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: The boxes are being swapped. Right now.

options.text: Run there with your phone and film everything.
Get Tobi's boys and stuff a box of your own. Fight fire with fire.
Wake the VC's office. Let the adults handle it.

escaped.toast: You get away with four minutes of red bandanas swapping ballot boxes. It goes on every WhatsApp group by sunrise.

caught.toast: They take your phone and throw it in the fish pond. Your SIM is fine. Your phone is a fish now.

beats.speaker: vc
beats.text: (announcing, very tired) After... irregularities... the election is decided. Student Union President: Tobiloba Adéyẹmí.

variants.text: (announcing, very tired) Student Union President: Tunde Adisa, also known as "Capo". (The back gate cheers. The hostels don't.)

beats.speaker: tobi
beats.text: (lifting you off the ground) We did it! You did it! My dad says I can have any car I want. I said I want a manifesto. (He pauses.) And a car.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Tobi never asks how the extra box got there. You never tell him. It sits between you at every party like a third guest.

beats.title: SUG Elections
beats.summary: A union, a ballot box, and a choice about how badly you wanted to win.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You watch the election from the library window. Tunde Capo wins. The union's budget buys four new red cars for the back gate. Tobi doesn't blame you out loud.

beats.title: SUG Elections
beats.summary: You sat it out. Sometimes that is wisdom. Sometimes it's just sitting.
